Own C17 map, fixtures, Python tooling and integration patch are MIT. This
candidate derives from the independently fetched Gufo pin
`f783fedb9bea2ec7de941f6da4e02f4a4596b29e` and the recorded `ssm-fixed-bounds`
composition. All thirteen numerical HIP/include sources remain byte-identical
to that measured parent. No sibling CachyOS or DS4 source/artifact is imported.

The1029-file [manifest](../../config/q2-iq2-tail16-source-v2.json) binds the

the fixture receive two different descriptor maps; they are not an independent
teacher. Counts in the three test distributions originate from the exact
saved1585 binary and original fixed2048 input, as bound by
[the route fixtures](../../config/q2-fixed-input-route-fixtures.json).
Component activations/weights remain synthetic and separate from model evidence.

No new numerical port, conversion table, dependency or driver change occurs.
Durable own source/evidence are preserved locally and under .157 `run/`;
rejected experiments and the two corrected local wiring errors remain retained.
